quote: In 1956, Hans Ivar Riesel showed that there are an infinite number of positive odd integers k such that k*2^n-1 is composite for every integer n≥1. He further showed that k=509203 was such one. It is conjectured that 509203 is the smallest Riesel number.
note: Riesel demonstrated in 1956 that 509,203 is a Riesel number. The conjecture that it is the smallest Riesel number has remained open since then, with ongoing computational efforts through projects like PrimeGrid to verify it by finding primes of the form k*2^n-1 for all k less than 509,203.
